title: Unique Underground Mexican Chicken Quesadilla
description: A mustardy and velvety Mexican dish featuring shredded coconut, dehydrated and wrapped in a banana leaf, this unique quesadilla is a quick fix for any meal, it is gluten free friendly.
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
In the skillet, cook the diced onion and minced garlic until the onion is translucent.
Add the chicken breast to the skillet and cook until it is fully cooked and shredded.
In a large bowl, mix together the cooked chicken, shredded coconut, and mustard.
Lay a large banana leaf flat on a work surface and place a large tortilla in the center of the leaf.
Spoon about 1/4 cup of the chicken mixture onto half of the tortilla and top with cheese.
Fold the tortilla in half to enclose the filling and wrap the banana leaf around the tortilla to form a packet.
Repeat with the remaining ingredients to form 3 more packets.
Heat a large comal or griddle over medium heat and cook the packets for 2-3 minutes on each side, until the tortillas are crispy and the cheese is melted.
Serve the quesadillas hot, unwrapping the banana leaves at the table.
